headline: Lil Durk @lildurk’s freedom is now in the jury’s hands as his trial reportedly enters deli
body: Lil Durk @lildurk’s freedom is now in the jury’s hands as his trial reportedly enters deliberations today. Closing arguments wrapped up yesterday, and jurors will now weigh the evidence before reaching a verdict. Durk faces a potential life sentence if convicted on all counts. There’s no set timeline for deliberations, meaning a verdict isn’t guaranteed today. He remains presumed innocent unless proven guilty.
